parameter_source: configs/paper_rebuild/clean5/CLEAN5_CALIBRATED_SENSOR_MODEL.yaml and CLEAN5_CALIBRATED_SENSOR_MODEL_CONTRACT.yaml; physical calibration copied, no fitting
engineering_differences: GTSAM 4.2 preintegration/factors replace OB-GINS factors; actual Ceres 2.2 via pyceres performs Algorithm 2 relinearization; not author code
Fixed local NED and first-order Earth rotation/Coriolis replace OB-GINS full Earth-aware mechanization
One legal A1 yaw initializes a segment; no repeated heading factor, RP or HV factor
After relinearization retain T1-1 nodes per Algorithm 2 line 15; next node rebuilds at T1
Cache tail after prefix Givens, before tail elimination, to retain prefix effects; exact incremental/full QR parity tested
Absolute wrap-safe attitude increments trigger A-JSWR; no reference-dependent threshold
Bias random-walk densities use sigma_stationary*sqrt(2/tau), rather than interpreting stationary sigma as density
First-1000 gyro mean removal is represented by initial residual gyro bias -R0^T*omega_ie; no provider modification

Initial GNSS1 antenna velocity is converted to IMU velocity by subtracting R*(omega_body cross lever); omega uses the latest completed calibrated increment divided by its unrounded raw duration; absent legal rate leaves the node unavailable until initialization is supported
Initial zero accelerometer bias uses the calibrated stationary bias uncertainty, not a falsely precise zero-bias constraint
Observed IMU gaps preserve NaN nodes and restart an independent sensor-initialized segment only after continuous support resumes
Fractional right-endpoint IMU intervals retain original GNSS timestamps; the next-IMU-sample availability delay is recorded, never labeled zero-latency causal output
Unrounded raw timestamps recover each frozen provider increment's exact current-sample duration; raw inertial values are never applied a second time
